resolvedFormerDebts: The fallback is state-specific rather than a generic four-block composition.
Unit direct-entry coverage iterates all 15 states.
The controller no longer publishes a fictitious settled-camera snapshot; the render adapter owns actual damping.
The production runtime imports the minimal runtime-state projection rather than the full evidence manifest.
Development controls and state/seed diagnostics are absent from production executable assets and source maps.
Reduced motion uses demand rendering, immediate poses, no pointer trail, and discrete DOM handoffs.

blockingEvidence.issue: Deterministic recording measurement resolves 4 primary landmarks and 3 auxiliary route cores, but 11 primary landmarks remain explicitly blocked. Landing and 11 journey states have live DOM contracts, yet the last captured implementation fails all 13 applicable DOM states.
The forward, reverse, direct-jump, resize, and restored-scroll convergence suite is authored but has not run successfully against the current checkpoint.
The procedural world, route projection, static cameras, materials, lighting, effects, and geometry have not passed state-specific structural and visual tolerances.
Loader, landing packets, field pulse cadence, pointer-trail appearance, and arrival timing remain comparison candidates rather than accepted source matches.
Performance evidence is not an acceptance run on locked hardware; the development software-renderer run also exceeded frame-time, long-task, and mobile CLS budgets.

acceptance.reason: The architecture and evidence machinery are implemented and buildable, but the current checkpoint has no complete browser convergence/capture run and the last source-linked visual gate is red and stale. No Phase 5 or later acceptance is claimed.
